deltas.existing_clean_key_text: Viññāṇa is temporally (?) antecedent to nāmarūpa and logically a subdivision of it.
deltas.direct_image_secure_key_text: viññāna is temporally (?) an antecedent of nāma-rūpam, & logically a subdivision of it.
deltas.correction: The relation phrase is diplomatically ‘an antecedent of’, not ‘antecedent to’. The manuscript also uses the form ‘nāma-rūpam’ in this sentence; normalized conceptual prose may continue to use nāmarūpa if explicitly marked as normalization.
deltas.material_layout_observation: The diagram immediately above nests viññānam under nāma within nāmarūpam while the prose assigns temporal antecedence and logical subdivision. No visible erasure removes either relation.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: The prior relation-type argument survives; the correction is diplomatic rather than conceptual.

deltas.witness_grade: W3 for key rejection/conclusion; W1-W2 for the crossed/overwritten temporal-homogeneity phrase immediately above
deltas.existing_clean_key_text: there is, he argues, a discoverable technical system underlying the arrangement.
deltas.direct_image_secure_key_text: There is a discoverable logical system wh. governs the arrangement, and the repetitions are intentional; as I hope I have succeeded in showing.
deltas.additional_secure_text: The page directly rejects the claim that the formula is ‘illogical & unintelligible’ or that its terms were ‘jumbled together in an order more or less accidental.’
deltas.correction: Replace the normalized descriptor ‘technical system’ with the manuscript’s ‘logical system’ when representing Lovejoy’s own wording or conceptual vocabulary. Do not preserve the older normalized ‘strict temporal relation’ as diplomatic wording for the crossed clause.
deltas.hold: Do not freeze the exact crossed/overwritten word(s) in the immediately preceding clause about the sequence being non-homogeneous until a still tighter paleographic read is needed for quotation.
deltas.material_layout_observation: The sentence crosses the gutter; homogeneous is inserted above the first right-leaf line and the following qualifier is struck/overwritten, making the revision materially visible.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: This materially strengthens the claim that Lovejoy’s local problem is one of relation and intelligible arrangement, not merely technical taxonomy. It does not establish a later unit-idea method or a Buddhist origin for it.

deltas.direct_image_secure_fragment: precede both temporally as well as logically
deltas.correction: The existing clean summary’s distinction between temporal and logical precedence is directly supported by the page image rather than being an editorial synthesis.
deltas.material_layout_observation: The left leaf carries the dense argument while almost the whole facing right leaf is blank except for a short top continuation, marking an abrupt thought-block closure.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: p.50 independently repeats the relation-type vocabulary found on p.42, reducing the chance that ms p.123 is an isolated formulation.

deltas.witness_grade: W3 for heading/source anchor, ontological-function passage and A.O.L. question; W1-W2 for some compressed technical forms

The explicit A.O.L. initials are retained as a material source/author seam; exact compressed Pāli/Sanskrit items in the alternate series remain a quotation-level queue rather than a conceptual blocker.
deltas.material_layout_observation: A.O.L. is written immediately after the ontological-function question inside the dense two-leaf source/analysis run.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: The page makes the historical-genealogical question distinct from the logical-arrangement question secured on pp.49-50 and explicitly marks one local Lovejoy intervention.

deltas.witness_grade: W3 for the key evaluative transitions; W1-W2 for several compressed middle clauses
direct_image_secure_fragments: the whole enumeration is secondary as to origin & composite as to character
plainly only a scholastic expedient, without warrant
theory, conceived all of a piece
deltas.correction: The clean summary is conceptually sustained and now carries diplomatic anchors: Lovejoy distinguishes composite/secondary origin from the later scholastic work of making the inherited terms cohere. No stronger direct-borrowing claim is licensed.
deltas.material_layout_observation: A continuing upper-left paragraph gives way to a standalone namarupa question lower on the leaf; the argument continues on the right and ends mid-page, leaving substantial blank space.
deltas.interpretive_consequence: The local sequence separates historical origin, logical arrangement, and scholastic reconciliation. These should not be flattened into one chronology or one contradiction claim.
